decisions.decision: Orlandi replication is a follow-up paper, not this revision
decisions.rationale: Cost/benefit asymmetric under 5-day deadline. Three outcomes (A) Orlandi-works-quantum-still-wins requires headline restructure; (B) Orlandi-beats-quantum catastrophic to current claim; (C) Orlandi-fails-to-replicate creates high-conflict 'we couldn't replicate' subsection. Expected value negative under deadline. Strategic two-paper play instead: submit current paper as-is, do Orlandi replication study as a focused follow-up using the 2-3 months between submission and decision.
